items.text: Rip Van Winkle lived in a little village at the foot of the Kaatskill Mountains. <break time="0.8s" /> He was a simple, good-natured man; <break time="0.8s" /> and he was, moreover, a kind neighbour. <break time="0.8s" /> “Where’s Rip?” asked the men — nobody knew. <break time="0.8s" /> In 1776, Dr. Smith paid $3.50 for 20% of it. <break time="0.8s" /> Yes.
